description: This file provides a portable implementation of the Oracle OCI8 driver with specific modifications such as lowercase column names and '?' parameter binding, extending the standard ADODB OCI8 driver. It defines classes for database connection and recordset handling with tailored methods for parameter preparation, query execution, and result fetching.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8po
classes.description: Extended Oracle OCI8 driver supporting lowercase column names and '?' parameter binding, with methods for preparing, executing, and limiting queries, inheriting from ADODB_oci8.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8po
classes.description: Recordset class for OCI8 po driver, providing methods for fetching fields, moving to the next record, and retrieving limited arrays.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Returns a '?' placeholder for parameter binding.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement by replacing '?' with ':0', ':1', etc., for Oracle.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with optional input parameters.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Performs a select query with a limit and offset, using the slower base class method due to driver incompatibilities.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Handles SQL query execution, replacing parameter markers appropriately.

methods.name: extractBinds
methods.description: Converts '?' placeholders to Oracle-style bind variables, considering string literals and escapes.
